stories.title: Flintshire’s funding formula is under review, but not in time for next year’s budget
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has commissioned a review of the formula used to decide how much funding Flintshire County Council receives, with any change unable to take effect before 2028-29. stories.title: Oakenholt mill gets £2.85m upgrade with hydrogen-ready burners
stories.summary: Essity is to spend £2.85 million upgrading the paper machine at its Oakenholt mill near Flint. The Swedish company, whose brands include Velvet, Cushelle, Tork and TENA, said the work will replace the machine’s hood, burner and heat exchange systems. stories.title: Hope House Tŷ Gobaith launches new Midnight Pyjama Walk fundraiser
stories.summary: A new family-friendly Midnight Pyjama Walk has been launched in aid of Hope House Tŷ Gobaith children’s hospices.
